purpose: Gate 0 item 2 — regenerated bundle manifest. Two-level hash (A18 §C4) unchanged in DESIGN from A21; this regeneration fixes the bug where A21's own manifest_hash_formula was excluded from the content it hashed (it should be bound INTO the hash, only manifest_hash itself excluded), and rebuilds input_spec_hash from ONE canonical bundleSpec object literally shared with the runtime validator (game/src/blockout-validate.js), not a parallel re-implementation.
authority: ZERO-PROP (A15/A16/A20's adopted park-all-29 default) — same authority A21 targeted.
input_spec_hash_formula: sha256(canonicalStringify(buildBundleSpec({grid, boundaryPolicy, props, resolution:{43,CFG.tile}, playerRadiusFraction:CFG.playerRadius, contactBandVersion, maskGeneratorVersion}))) — see game/src/blockout-validate.js buildBundleSpec()/canonicalStringify(), the SAME functions the runtime validator calls.
runtime_validation_sequence: 1. Recompute input_spec_hash from the LIVE selected bundle (window.ARENA) + CFG, using the exact buildBundleSpec()/canonicalStringify() functions this generator also calls — must equal this manifest's input_spec_hash.
2. Fetch each of the 3 mask PNGs' raw bytes and recompute SHA-256 fresh — must equal this manifest's per-file images.<role>.sha256, individually.
3. Recompute this manifest's own content (every field except manifest_hash — manifest_hash_formula included, unlike the old A21 bug) and rehash — must equal manifest_hash below.

Any ONE mismatch fails closed — boot STOPS with a full-screen staging error under blockout mode; it never partially trusts a bundle matching on some but not all components, and never silently falls back to the ordinary path.

supersedes.reason: A21's manifest_hash_formula excluded itself from the hashed content (only correct half of "exclude only manifest_hash" — Gate 0 item 2's instruction). A21 is left exactly as filed, not edited; this is a NEW corrected regeneration, consumed by the actual runtime.

manifest_hash_formula: sha256(canonicalStringify(manifest_dict_excluding_ONLY_the_manifest_hash_field)) — manifest_hash_formula itself IS included in the hashed content this time.
